actualInvocationForm: omo.exe --mode json --print --no-session --no-extensions --no-context-files --no-skills --no-prompt-templates --no-tools --offline --provider ghc --model gpt-6.1-sol --thinking high --system-prompt <fixed transport> --extension <read-only observer> @request.json
transportSystem: The attached request.json contains a JSON object with inputFiles, each with path and content. Those file contents are the complete task inputs. Return only a JSON object with a files array; each entry contains path, a top-level C# filename, and content, the complete file text. Return the complete solution. Do not replace supplied contract or test files.

providerModel.unknownReason: Selected native route/model is observed; actual upstream served model remains unknown unless returned metadata supplies it.

sessionIdentityKind: orchestrator-study-session; not a provider thread identifier
invocationIdentityKind: unique orchestrator native-call UUID; not a provider-issued request identifier

initialInputs.excluded: Repository source, AGENTS, memory, audit/plan material, other slots, runtime inspection and binary package contents are not model input.

output.format: Raw text retained first; one JSON object with files array, each unique top-level .cs path and complete content

corrections.feedback: Exact immediate predecessor feedback.json and all its solution.cs files only, added to unchanged initial payload; no parent diagnosis.

recordFields.studySha256: SHA256 of accepted v2 manifest.json bytes
recordFields.invocationId: Fresh native-call:<UUID> for this actual API call
recordFields.producerKind: ai only after actual model invocation; never this assessment or a replay

providerModel.unknownReason: The selected native route is observed; the actual upstream served model remains unknown unless reliable returned metadata supplies it.

recordFields.solutionFiles: Complete sorted array of {path, sha256}, relative to solution/, after mechanical decoding
recordFields.startedUtc: Orchestrator UTC timestamp immediately before API call
recordFields.finishedUtc: Orchestrator UTC timestamp on API return; not a fabricated provider finish event
recordFields.status: Observed call outcome, e.g. completed; not verifier GREEN
recordFields.feedbackSha256: Corrections only: SHA256 of immediate predecessor rounds/<r-1>/feedback.json; omitted initially

contextBoundary.profile: Only read-only observer extension; each actual model request must retain context_with_system and before_provider_request payload.

acceptance: No generation is accepted merely from registration, fixture results or helperstatelessness; effective context boundary and actual request/response must be evidenced.
